children.text: One black island where the toolbar was: the site and its address. No back, forward, star, extensions, downloads or menu on show. Back and forward stay on Alt+← → and the mouse buttons; everything else is one hover away.
The island widens a little under the pointer and shows its controls inside itself: back and forward at its ends, star, extensions and the menu after the address. Leave it and it settles back.
A tab plays sound: the island takes the album art at its start and moving sound bars at its end, like the phone's. The address stays readable between them.

children.text: A download splits off a small round island beside the main one, with its progress as a ring. It flows back into the island when done.

children.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.18)" stroke-width="2.2"/><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#ededed" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="31.2 60" transform="rotate(-90 10 10)"/></svg>

children.text: Both at once: art and sound bars in the island, the ring in its bubble. Never more than two shapes.

<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.18)" stroke-width="2.2"/><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#ededed" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="31.2 60" transform="rotate(-90 10 10)"/></svg>

children.text: For a few seconds the island stretches to say so, with Open. Then it settles back to the address.

children.name: Label · 7 · Click while playing: now playing

children.text: The island grows down into a card, the way the phone's does: art, title, a scrubber and the controls. Click outside and it shrinks back into the island.

children.name: Label · 8 · Extensions (the puzzle in the hovered island)

children.text: 8 · Extensions (the puzzle in the hovered island)
The island opens into your extensions as a row of icons with their names, the ones that work on this page first. Click one and its own window opens from the island.

children.name: 8 · Extensions (the puzzle in the hovered island)

children.text: Click or Ctrl+L: the island widens into the address field, and suggestions grow out of it as one shape (no separate popup).
